name: Scroll Parallax Gallery
description: Smooth-scrolling editorial gallery where each image drifts and tilts in 3D as it passes through the viewport, with large overlapping titles, short descriptions and a scroll-to-top button.
contents: Large page title with animated scroll arrows
Alternating image blocks with title and description
behavior: Page scroll is smoothed with a lerped transform on the content
Images shift vertically and rotate in 3D based on scroll position
Scroll to top button appears after 40 percent of scroll
Reduced motion preference disables easing and rotation
editableByProps: Items, titles, descriptions, images and aspect ratios
Background, text and description colors as Tailwind classes
Scroll easing, rotation range and image width
fixed: Takes over page scrolling: the content is fixed and moved by transform while body height is set to match, reset on unmount
Component renders fixed inset-0 and covers the whole viewport
Mobile layout stacks text over the image below 40em
